name: gojijeon
description: LAN 4~8인 실시간 대전 게임 — 무기 하나, 땅굴, 자원

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.host: npm run build && npm run start -w @gojijeon/server
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && node --test --test-timeout=30000 packages/server/test/*.test.js
